t: This is the Royal Albert Hall, a concert hall on the northern edge of South Kensington. It seats 5,272 people. It takes its name from Prince Albert, who was Queen Victoria's husband and consort from 1840 until he died in 1861. It was designed by two Royal Engineers. Captain Francis Fowke was an engineer and architect who used new technologies to build iron-framed buildings with large open spaces. Major-General Henry Scott is best known as the joint designer and builder of the Hall.
